input.description: When this hiker reaches the summit, there are two other hikers that carry their backpacks. What are the colors of these backpacks?

task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A man in a blue t-shirt, sunglasses, and a purple backpack holds a camera in a selfie-style view while walking along a steep, rocky mountain ridge covered in green grass and small yellow flowers. He wears a climbing harness with carabiners and holds a green trekking pole in his left hand. The background reveals a vast, hazy mountain landscape under a bright blue sky. As he walks, he looks down at the path and then up at the camera, speaking. The camera angle shifts slightly, showing the rugged terrain and the drop-off to the side. In the final frame, the view pans down to show the rocky, grassy path and a large white rock formation ahead.
